$doc: What the renderer reports of a frame (pxl-render gpu/renderer.rs): the GPU spans it is timed in,
in the order the renderer encodes them, and the kind of frame it made; the profiler records and reports
$GPU_SPAN_NAMES: `world` is the world's pass as it lays the opaque world, and `world_rest` the pass that goes on after the occlusion is found between them (`ao`), drawing over it the occlusion's map, the sky and what the kernel animates; where the occlusion is not found again the one pass draws it all, timed as `world`, and `world_rest` runs none. A span is `per_px` where every pass it times runs threads over the world's drawn pixels, its fragments or a thread a pixel or a square of them, so its cost goes with the drawn resolution; a span whose passes do not all is split until each is one or the other. `per_px`: the world's passes, its occlusion, its gathering and the depth's bound (`resolve`), the boxes drawn into the visibility buffer (`sraster`), the pixels' cast and their misses' walk, the screen's marks, its tiles' words set and the marks drawn over the world's depth (`mark`), the light's changed tiles propagated to the screen's, a thread a square of its pixels (`propagate`), and the tiles of the light's box the world's receivers stand on, marked where the eye's rays meet it, a thread a drawn pixel (`light_receivers`); the drawn resolution's scale is judged on these alone (pxl-render gpu/renderer.rs `px_ms`, pxl-kernel domain/view/frame/resolution.rs). Not `per_px`: the camera grid's beam rays, cells, samples, their boxes written (`sample_box`) and their faces, on its own angular lattice (`beam`, `cell`, `sample`, `face`); the light's cast, its slide, the drawn receivers' marks, its propagation, its beam rays and cells (`light_beam`), its samples (`light_sample`), their boxes (`light_raster`), its slots (`light_slot`) and their walks (`light_walk`), at the map's texels and tiles; the light's marks, its tiles' words set, the marks drawn over its map and their box's args (`light_mark`), at the map's texels; the node cache's forgetting, over its entries (`cast`); and the canvas's passes, at the display's pixels, the markers' text among them (`finish`, `marker`, `debug`). A span is `per_cell` where every pass it times runs over the camera grid's lattice, its corners or its cells (pxl-engine `beam::Grid`), so its cost goes with their count, the lattice's side squared over: the beam rays (`beam`) and the cells' starts (`cell`); the samples, their boxes and their faces are as many at every lattice (`sample`, `sample_box`, `face`), and a sample walks from its coarser cell's start the farther; the light runs the same entries over its map's lattice, which no knob changes (`light_beam`, `light_sample`). The lattice is judged on these alone (pxl-render gpu/renderer.rs `cell_ms`, pxl-kernel domain/view/frame/resolution.rs).
$LIGHT_MOVED: Why the light's map cast, a bit each, bit k the k-th (pxl-render gpu/ray/cast.rs `light_moved`): what it reads moved, the light's frame, the eye's zooms its bands are held to, the world under it or the shadows' setting (`content`); the box slid (`slide`); which tiles the receivers read, the eye's place and look, the actors' places or decor compacted again (`receivers`); or the footprints owed the first frame the eye stands in after it moved (`footprint`).
$FRAME_KINDS: What the renderer made of a frame turn, where it decides it (pxl-render gpu/renderer.rs `render_frame`, `FrameKind`): `none` before it was asked; `unready` with no device or surface, or while the renderer is made before its first frame (`Pipelines::share`); `held` where the surfaces would block (not admitted); `dropped` where the frame did not fit the GPU stream; `plain` drawn with nothing cast; `standing` drawn on the standing ray lane; `cast` drawn with a cast; `stood` where nothing the frame reads changed, so nothing is drawn or submitted and the canvases keep what they show; `px` drawn with the pixels cast again over samples that stood, where only the eye's jitter moved (pxl-engine `eye::JITTER`); `gated` drawn through the gate where only what the kernel bounds moved: the claimed screen tiles alone drawn again, the rest standing (pxl-render gpu/renderer.rs `GATE_NUMBERS`, screen_tiles.wgsl).
